title: Spanner: Google's Globally-Distributed Database
author: Corbett et al. (OSDI 2012)
why: The reference design for consistent multi-region writes: Paxos-replicated shards, TrueTime and commit wait.

title: A comprehensive study of Convergent and Commutative Replicated Data Types
author: Shapiro, Preguiça, Baquero and Zawirski (INRIA, 2011)
why: The formal foundation of CRDTs, with the G-Counter, PN-Counter, OR-Set and others specified precisely.

title: Dynamo: Amazon's Highly Available Key-value Store
author: DeCandia et al. (SOSP 2007)
why: Vector clocks, application-level merges and the shopping-cart example of choosing availability over consistency.

title: Global tables: multi-active, multi-Region replication
author: Amazon Web Services
why: A production multi-writer design: how replication works, how conflicts are reconciled and what consistency modes exist.
